Many are convinced that identical twins, sharing essentially the same DNA, have different psychological profiles only if raised in different environments, and similar psychological profiles if raised in similar environments, and there’s plenty of evidence to that effect. So if your claim is something like “I’m basically the same person I was when I was a child”, you might get some evidence to support that claim.
